notes: Version 2.39 records Foundation 2.5. Foundation cites ENI Corollary 6 with its own premises on each projection (surjectivity, observables defined by the projection, a level not isomorphic to the one below), which the axioms A1-A4 do not supply and which are open for the strata proposed by the programme. The ENI entry, table row and graph node state ENI's theorem as a one-way implication under its premises (Theorem 3), with the equivalence of descriptive redundancy, non-injectivity and positive projection entropy under the same premises (Corollary 5) and colour confinement under the same premises at the colour stratum, whose identification is open. ENI motivates Axiom A2 without deriving it: Foundation retains A2 as a local axiom because the ENI premises are not established for the local transition map. The effective metric read from the principal symbol of the limit operator is conditional on the spatial limit hypothesis [H-L] and on the open lifting hypothesis [H-lift] of Q5b; the signature result gives (-,+,+) on the rank-three non-degenerate block only, a Lorentzian signature requiring a full-rank extension that is not constructed. Foundation writes W for the finite Weil modules of the supplied Heisenberg-Schrödinger carrier, one per non-trivial central character, the member at c being the Weil block V_c of O27, whose Weil action is not the Heisenberg action; V_rho denotes only the spinor carrier C^2 supplied conditionally by O23. The Foundation entry states that the proto-state is defined and its structural indeterminacy derived from A1 and A3, that irreducibility and non-commutation require a representation-theoretic dictionary, and that the axioms do not select the Heisenberg group (Foundation Theorem 5.7). The Foundation entry carries version 2.5; the Foundation and ENI entries, table rows and graph nodes carry the new wording; the Q5b entry carries version 2.2.1. The identifications F_n = V_rho in the FM-Note entry, in HeisenbergCarrierObstruction and on the fermionic-matter and Q14 web pages are not resolved in this version.
